title: How Much Does the Judge Inflate Your ASR? A Calibration Replication

original_idea.body: Replicating the non-monotonic safety curve (extends arXiv:2606.00813) on a second open family (Qwen2/2.5/3 or LLaMA-2/3/3.1) with a fixed red-team battery; per-generation ASR with CIs.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Testing whether 'newer=safer' fails generally is a concrete, deployment- and governance-relevant safety chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Fixed prompt battery across model generations, single-GPU inference; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped per-generation ASR comparison with CIs.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public weights, no lab resources, regulator-relevant replication; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Replication on a second family does not exist per the idea; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No second-family replication of the non-monotonic dip exists.
